# Jupiter guarded-swap pilot closeout

Use this template after one separately approved pilot. Store it only in the
partner-approved workspace; it may reference private evidence artifacts but
must not copy private keys, credentials, full transaction bytes, or raw wallet
data into an operational dashboard.
